channels.name: metalshaper (Brian)
channels.description: Brian's metal shop, specializing in Willys Jeep vehicle restorations — full-body metal fabrication from single panels to entire body tubs.
channels.verificationMethod: Confirmed canonical channel ID via direct channel-page fetch (youtube.com/channel/UCTHDVml1xugLuj0oi384tEQ).
channels.notes: Source directory attributed the '@metalshaper' handle to metal-shaping pioneer Ron Fournier, but the actual channel at that handle belongs to a different creator (Brian, Willys Jeep restorations) — Ron Fournier passed away in 2017 per a YouTube tribute video and does not appear to have had a personal channel. Included under its real, verified ownership rather than the source directory's (incorrect) attribution.

notes: 2026-07-20: Created from scratch, merging all 29 rows from the founder-provided 'welding_metal_fabrication_resources.csv' (Section I.5) — this file had no prior entries. Four of the CSV's 10 channels could not be used as-cited: 'WeldingWeb TV' (no dedicated YouTube channel found for the forum brand — its forum itself was kept as this file's Forum blog entry), 'Chucke2009' (excluded — multiple independent welding-community forum threads report the channel turned to offensive/inflammatory non-welding content in recent years), 'Kenya Jua Kali Sector' (no channel by this name found — only scattered individual news-outlet videos about the sector), and 'Scratch Build Weld' (no matching channel found). 'Metalshaper (Ron Fournier)' was also corrected: the real @metalshaper-style channel belongs to a different creator (Brian, Willys Jeep restorations), not metal-shaping pioneer Ron Fournier, who passed away in 2017. Four independently-verified, directly on-topic replacements were substituted to reach 10 channels: Weld.com, The Fab Forums (Kyle Voss), Ron Covell, and 6061.com. Every real YouTube channel ID was independently looked up via search and channel-page fetches — the CSV's RSS_Feed column universally used a literal 'UC...' placeholder rather than real channel IDs.
